  "version": 2,
  "classification_note": "本库人工整理的表达方式标签，不是任何会议期刊的官方绘图规范；配色为绘制建议，未从每张原图精确取色。",
  "layouts": [
    {
      "id": "L01",
      "name": "线性流水线",
      "slug": "linear-pipeline",
      "definition": "单条主链横向或纵向推进，输入、变换与输出顺序清楚。",
      "use_when": "输入到输出的顺序方法、数据处理、推理流程。",
      "avoid_when": "把真正并行的模态硬挤成一条链。",
      "prompt_clause": "Use one aligned main pipeline with consistent module sizes; show each transformation in reading order. Route auxiliary links outside the main chain.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "2:1"
    },
    {
      "id": "L02",
      "name": "多分支与汇合",
      "slug": "parallel-fusion",
      "definition": "多条并行编码/处理支路，明确融合、共享或分叉节点。",
      "use_when": "多模态、双编码器、教师学生、多个任务头。",
      "avoid_when": "支路交叉或共享模块语义不清。",
      "prompt_clause": "Use parallel aligned lanes for the branches, explicit merge/split nodes and a clearly labelled fusion operation. Keep shared and branch-specific modules distinct.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "2:1"
    },
    {
      "id": "L03",
      "name": "层级编码解码",
      "slug": "hierarchical-encoder-decoder",
      "definition": "按层级、分辨率或网络深度排列，跨层联系与跳连可见。",
      "use_when": "U-Net、FPN、层级网络、深层展开。",
      "avoid_when": "没有层级意义却使用复杂U形。",
      "prompt_clause": "Arrange the network by depth or resolution; align corresponding encoder/decoder levels. Route skip connections in reserved gutters and distinguish add from concat when supplied.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "3:2"
    },
    {
      "id": "L04",
      "name": "模块总览与局部放大",
      "slug": "modular-inset",
      "definition": "外层方法总览加子模块容器/插图，建立整体到细节的层级。",
      "use_when": "复杂总体框架与一个核心创新模块。",
      "avoid_when": "各插图同等拥挤、放大框与总图没有对应。",
      "prompt_clause": "Create a clear overview and one or two bounded detail insets. Repeat module identifiers to connect overview and detail; group boundaries must not look like data-flow arrows.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "2:1"
    },
    {
      "id": "L05",
      "name": "节点关系与消息传递",
      "slug": "node-link-graph",
      "definition": "显式节点与边，邻居、关系类型或聚合目标以位置/颜色区分。",
      "use_when": "GNN、知识图谱、因果DAG、关系推理。",
      "avoid_when": "把模块之间所有箭头都叫消息传递。",
      "prompt_clause": "Draw explicit node-link graphs with visible adjacency and relation labels where required. Distinguish internal illustrative graph edges from directed system-flow arrows; highlight the target node and aggregation only if specified.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "3:2"
    },
    {
      "id": "L06",
      "name": "token矩阵与算子展开",
      "slug": "token-matrix-operator",
      "definition": "用token条、矩阵、张量或离散序列展现操作过程。",
      "use_when": "注意力、mask、patch、索引编码与张量机制。",
      "avoid_when": "将概念矩阵画成带数值结果的统计热图。",
      "prompt_clause": "Use token strips, tensor tiles and operator nodes to expose the computation. Preserve supplied tensor dimensions and sequence order; schematic colors encode roles, not fabricated measurements.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "2:1"
    },
    {
      "id": "L07",
      "name": "迭代与反馈回路",
      "slug": "iteration-feedback",
      "definition": "重复步骤、训练更新或环境交互以回路/时间箭头表达。",
      "use_when": "扩散逆过程、优化更新、RL、工具循环。",
      "avoid_when": "给只读检索系统添加不存在的回答回写。",
      "prompt_clause": "Make iteration direction and the repeated unit explicit. Route feedback outside the forward path; draw a loop only when the supplied edge list contains it. Separate interaction, learning and control links.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "2:1"
    },
    {
      "id": "L08",
      "name": "分阶段泳道",
      "slug": "stage-swimlane",
      "definition": "离线/在线、训练/推理、客户端/服务端等按容器分轨。",
      "use_when": "RAG离线在线、训练测试、系统分层工作流。",
      "avoid_when": "把分组边界当连线或将阶段混在同一轨。",
      "prompt_clause": "Use labelled stage or responsibility swimlanes. Align chains within each lane and route cross-lane links through a clear gutter. Stage containers are grouping devices; cross-stage read/write directions must follow the brief.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "2:1"
    },
    {
      "id": "L09",
      "name": "多面板机制对照",
      "slug": "multi-panel-comparison",
      "definition": "以(a)(b)等面板对照结构或机制变化，保留相同基准位置。",
      "use_when": "基线与新方法、不同阶段、不同机制设计。",
      "avoid_when": "用实验结果曲线替代机制对照。",
      "prompt_clause": "Use comparable panels with aligned input/output positions and consistent visual vocabulary. Emphasize structural differences with one accent color; panels compare mechanisms, not invented numerical performance.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "2:1"
    },
    {
      "id": "L10",
      "name": "概念示意与场景隐喻",
      "slug": "conceptual-scene",
      "definition": "图标、人物、物体或几何场景解释任务、概念与动作。",
      "use_when": "任务动机、具身环境、科学机制直观说明。",
      "avoid_when": "装饰场景代替算法结构或暗示无根据的生物因果。",
      "prompt_clause": "Use a restrained explanatory scene or a few consistent icons, connected to the stated mechanism. Keep illustration subordinate to scientific meaning; do not add decorative characters or new claims.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "3:2"
    },
    {
      "id": "L11",
      "name": "树状层级与路由",
      "slug": "tree-hierarchy",
      "definition": "自顶向下层次、树节点、搜索路径或分层服务栈。",
      "use_when": "层次池化、树检索、任务路由、系统栈。",
      "avoid_when": "把一般DAG误画成只能有单父节点的树。",
      "prompt_clause": "Use a clear hierarchy with aligned levels and labelled parent-child or routing relations. Preserve multiple parents if the supplied structure is a DAG; do not force it into a tree.",
      "suggested_aspect_ratio": "3:2"
    }
  ],
  "visuals": [
    {
      "id": "V01",
      "name": "扁平柔和色块",
      "slug": "flat-muted",
      "definition": "白底、低饱和模块填充、细描边、少量圆角。",
      "suggested_palette": "#E4EDF6 / #E4F0E8 / #EEE7F4 / #FFF1D7",
      "prompt_clause": "Flat academic vector-like appearance on white; muted blue, green, lavender and amber functional groups; thin consistent dark-slate outlines; no shadows or gradients."
    },
    {
      "id": "V02",
      "name": "单色细线",
      "slug": "monochrome-line",
      "definition": "黑白/灰色线稿，通过边框与线型区分语义。",
      "suggested_palette": "#FFFFFF / #E5E7EB / #475569 / #111827",
      "prompt_clause": "Monochrome line art with white and light-gray fills, crisp black/gray outlines and high legibility. Encode distinctions by labels and shapes rather than color alone."
    },
    {
      "id": "V03",
      "name": "张量层叠与轻透视",
      "slug": "tensor-isometric",
      "definition": "特征图、张量或网络层以堆叠片、薄立方体和轻透视表达。",
      "suggested_palette": "#CBDDED / #D3E6D3 / #ECDDC2 / #D9D1E8",
      "prompt_clause": "Represent supplied feature maps or tensors as thin stacked slabs with restrained consistent isometric perspective. Keep labels flat and legible; avoid glossy rendering, lighting effects or gratuitous depth."
    },
    {
      "id": "V04",
      "name": "图标场景与框图混合",
      "slug": "icon-scene-hybrid",
      "definition": "输入样例/场景/图标与模块框图并置，明确图示角色。",
      "suggested_palette": "#E4EDF6 / #F3E6C9 / #DCE8DE / #243247",
      "prompt_clause": "Combine clean flat process blocks with a small number of restrained explanatory icons or input-scene thumbnails. Keep a consistent illustration language and ample whitespace; scene content is schematic unless a real input is provided."
    },
    {
      "id": "V05",
      "name": "彩色节点关系图",
      "slug": "colored-node-link",
      "definition": "彩色节点和细边，以颜色表示节点角色或关系种类。",
      "suggested_palette": "#8CCFC5 / #E7BA7A / #A8A1D5 / #8CAED0",
      "prompt_clause": "Use muted colored circular nodes and fine neutral graph edges; reserve one stronger accent for the target or active neighborhood. Provide labels or a compact legend for semantic node roles, without fabricating graph measurements."
    },
    {
      "id": "V06",
      "name": "高对比模块强调",
      "slug": "high-contrast-modules",
      "definition": "较强色彩区分路径或新增模块；保持有限颜色。",
      "suggested_palette": "#4878B8 / #D9655B / #75A66D / #2F3542",
      "prompt_clause": "Use a limited high-contrast palette for major branches, with a single accent highlighting the stated contribution. Keep the background white and text dark; avoid neon, glow and visual clutter."
    }
  ]
}
